Package com.microservices.warehouse.applications.mapper

Class MessageMapper

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.applications.mapper.MessageMapper
@Service public class MessageMapper extends Object
Service class for mapping exceptions and response objects to standard response formats.

This service provides methods to create standardized ResponseMessage and ExceptionMessage objects for success responses and error handling, respectively.
